buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of DIG (SHQ) payable at

SHQ ITBP, (GANGTOK), SAMDUR, TADONG, GANGTOK, SIKKIM . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Which is issued by Concerned Municipality/Competent Authority? d. If registered as a Partnership Firm, please submit supporting documents such as the Partnership Dee d, Re gistration Certificate (if applicable), PAN Card of the Firm and Bank account accordingly. e. Scanned copy of FSSAI certificate with indicating kind of business like Manufacturing/Processing Unit / Wh olesaler/ Distributor/ Direct Seller or Retailer etc.) is an activity where food products is Manufacturer o r pro cured from a reliable manufacturer, distributor or wholesaler and sold to the ultimate end user. E.g. R etail Shop/ Fish/ Meat/Poultry shop/ Vegetable, Fruits and Dairy products. FSSAI valid for financial year 202 6-27 or beyond. If the validity of FSSAI certificate is near about to expire then submitted the Undertakin g for m. (Copy Attached). f. Latest Bank Solvency certificate with date from your concerned Branch. (Only Original Scanned Copy accepted ). g. Scanned copy of tender documents after fill-up duly signed. h. Exemption from EMD will be considered under the following circumstances only: It is mandatory to s ubmit a valid MSE certificate for products or services produced by the bidder or related to the bid, alon g wi th a valid Trademark certificate, GST, FSSAI, and MSE certificate. i. A scanned copy of the Bid Security Money/EMD must be upload along with the Bid documents; the ori ginal EMD must also be deposited at this office till date of opening of technical bid. j.
